name: Sarkoth
summary: On a southern plateau in the Valley of Trials, Sarkoth has left a young Darkspear hunter near death. Wounded beneath a tree, Hana'zua asks a passing warrior to kill the scorpid and bring back its mangled claw, so his last strike will count for something.

sections.title: A Matter of Honor
sections.body: In the Valley of Trials, the Horde tests aspiring warriors against Durotar's harsh desert. While hunting the valley's venomous creatures, young troll scout Hana'zua met a scorpid far larger and deadlier than the rest. He struck hard enough to mangle one pincer, but Sarkoth drove its tail into his chest. Now Hana'zua bleeds in the red dirt, fearing his life is near its end. He wants the beast dead before it can outlive him.

sections.title: The Plateau Terror
sections.body: Sarkoth roams a high mesa above the southern Valley of Trials. Hana'zua's blow left one claw shattered, but the scorpid still rules the ridge and attacks anyone who climbs the rocky path. Bring the scarred claw back to the wounded scout, and he will have proof that his last strike weakened the monster enough for someone to bring it down.

faq.answer: Sarkoth roams the high plateau south of Hana'zua's hiding place. Follow the dirt ramp winding up the canyon wall to the ridge.

Hana'zua is a young Darkspear troll on his hunting trials in the Valley of Trials. Sarkoth mauled and envenomed him, and he lies beneath a tree asking a passing adventurer to avenge him before his wounds claim him.

faq.q: Why does Hana'zua want Sarkoth's claw?
faq.answer: Hana'zua shattered Sarkoth's claw with a fierce blow before the scorpid stung him. Bringing back the mangled claw proves the beast is dead and gives Hana'zua pride in his final fight.

faq.q: Does Hana'zua die from the venom?
faq.answer: Though gravely wounded and bitter over what he sees as failure, Hana'zua finds enough hope when Sarkoth falls to send you to the Den for medical aid.

faq.q: What makes Sarkoth different from other scorpids?
faq.answer: Sarkoth is larger and more aggressive than the scorpid workers on the lower valley floor. One claw bears the mark of Hana'zua's blow.

faq.q: What is the follow-up task after killing Sarkoth?
faq.answer: After you bring Sarkoth's claw to Hana'zua, he urges you to hurry to the Den, tell the camp leaders of his plight, and bring help before the venom proves fatal.

angles.text: As a Darkspear, you answer Hana'zua's plea as kin and see that a tribe member's honorable stand is recognized across Durotar's sands.
As an orc, you know the pain of dying without victory. Avenging Hana'zua lets an untested scout see his foe brought low.
As a member of the Horde, you come to a fallen comrade's aid in the Valley of Trials, where that bond gives strength to Thrall's people.
